messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — NimbusTech (midmarket) dropped daily requests ~60% this week, renewal in 28 days. Onboarding NPS 6, last enablement 3 weeks ago. Seeing lots of 0.5x token usage on prod routes. Thinking a targeted micro-save.
Samir Patel: Can you paste the usage graph and any billing flags?
Maya Chen: https://app.redwood/usage/nimbus (link) — no billing alerts yet. They rolled back a perf change last week but traffic never recovered. Primary cause appears to be their ETL/backfill paused during PoC, so devs put integrations on hold.
Elena R.: I can run a 30m focused enablement session: prompt templates, batching, KV cache quick wins. Recommend offering a temporary burst credit while we stabilize.
Tom B.: +1. Also propose a downgrade-swap safety path: keep them on base Dedicated, throttle non-critical routes, apply a usage credit. Draft wording below.
Tom B.: ```Hi Alice — we can apply a temporary throttle to non-core endpoints and provide a 20% usage credit for the next 30 days while we investigate. No contract changes required. We'll monitor and share weekly updates.```
Maya Chen: Love that. Action items: Elena to book enablement, Tom to draft the credit email, Samir to open an internal incident to monitor perf, I'll flag renewal owner and AM. Assigning Elena, Tom, Samir, Maya.
playbook-bot: New play created: "micro-engage-escalate" (PL-5921).
Elena R.: Booked 30m for Tue 10am PT — invite sent. I'll prep a checklist: immediate config fixes, batching knobs, KV cache suggestions, and a short eval prompt set.
Samir Patel: Opened INC-4231 for perf regressions, added eng-runtime oncall, set a 20% drop alert off baseline.
Maya Chen: Customer said: "we're putting devs on hold until perf stabilizes" — they requested weekly check-ins.
Tom B.: I'll post the credit email draft in the account thread and include a rollback/fallback clause to previous model if needed.
Tom B.: ```Draft email: Hi Alice — quick note: we can enable a temporary throttle + 20% usage credit; we'll monitor closely and give weekly updates. If the issue persists, we can revert model changes or flip to the fallback model to restore behavior.```
Elena R.: To capture feedback, ask them to run this 10-sample eval (link) and paste failing prompts. I'll collect examples in Notion and surface to eng.
Maya Chen: Timeline: enablement this week, credit offer by EOD, incident monitoring for 14 days, renewal owner review in 7 days. Samir — risk score?
Samir Patel: Risk score 7/10 — main drivers: product-fit signal + perf instability. Recommend AM escalation if score > 6.
Maya Chen: I'll cc AM and Legal for credit approval and move the account flag to "at-risk". Any objections?
Elena R.: none :thumbsup:
Tom B.: no objections :shipit: 
playbook-bot: PL-5921 updated — owners: Elena R., Tom B., Samir Patel; owner: Maya Chen; due_in: 7d.
Maya Chen: Thanks team — I'll post a short summary in Gainsight and update the account health flag. Will report back after enablement and first check-in.
